scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); const b = fs.existsSync('Backend') ? 'Backend' : 'backend'; const f = fs.existsSync('Frontend') ? 'Frontend' : 'frontend'; cp.execSync('npm install --prefix ' + b + ' && npm install --prefix ' + f + ' && npm run build --prefix ' + f, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const b = fs.existsSync('Backend') ? 'Backend' : 'backend'; require('./' + b + '/server.js');"
